laws.s2: Majikan wajib mengasuransikan pekerja untuk kecelakaan kerja.

laws.tp: Labor standards; domestic workers partly excluded
laws.s2: Menetapkan standar kerja. Pekerja rumah tangga hanya dilindungi sebagian.

laws.tp: Minimum wage in banking and finance and ICT only
laws.s2: Menetapkan upah minimum, tetapi hanya untuk sektor perbankan, keuangan, dan teknologi informasi.

coded.vl: The general labor statute applies in full
coded.n: Construction and agricultural workers are "employees" and, if manual, "workmen" under the Employment Act. Only seamen, domestic workers and managerial, executive or confidential staff are excluded. Domestic workers (BN-DW) differ: value 1.

The Minimum Wage Order covers only employees in the sectors listed in Schedule 1: banking, finance, ICT, telecoms and, since 1 April 2025, land survey, securities, private medical and education, security guards, tourism, travel agencies, architecture/engineering/QS firms and insurance. Construction contractors and agriculture are not listed.

coded.vi: Batas jam kerja menurut undang-undang berlaku
coded.n: At most 8 hours a day and 44 a week, 6 hours without a break, overtime at 1.5 times capped at 72 hours a month, and 12 hours a day in total; weekly rest day. The Commissioner may exempt employees from these limits (s 69). Domestic workers (BN-DW) differ: value 0.
coded.src: Employment Order 2009 Part VII · official text: https://www.agc.gov.bn/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/cap-278-2026-ed-employment-act.pdf

coded.vi: Hanya boleh pindah atas alasan tertentu, terbatas jumlahnya atau dengan persetujuan resmi
coded.vl: May change only on listed grounds, a limited number of times or with official approval
coded.n: Transfer to another employer needs the worker's consent and the Commissioner's endorsement (s 24). The licence to employ immigrant workers is held by the employer (s 112), and the pass may name the employer, with the holder to stay in the specified job (reg 15). Company change-of-employer endorsements need a Labour Department transfer form. Domestic workers (BN-DW) differ: value 0.

coded.vi: Boleh bergabung tetapi dibatasi hukum, atau status tinggal membuat keanggotaan nyaris teoretis
coded.vl: May join but faces legal limits, or residence status makes membership largely theoretical
coded.n: Same rules as for all workers: non-citizens may join, but may be officers only after 3 years of continuous service and residence in Brunei.

coded.vi: Biaya bagi pekerja dibatasi atau diatur
coded.vl: Fees charged to the worker are capped or regulated
coded.n: Same agency rules as for domestic workers: agencies may charge only the fees provided by the Order or regulations; the regulations prescribe only licence fees.

coded.vi: Hanya asuransi swasta atau kecelakaan yang dibeli majikan
coded.vl: Only employer-bought private or accident insurance is required
coded.n: Compulsory employer-bought medical insurance (at least $100,000; no wage deduction) and compulsory work-injury insurance with an approved insurer (Workmen's Compensation Act s 27; manual workers are covered whatever their pay).

coded.vi: Hanya saluran umum, atau saluran yang sulit dijangkau dari tempat kerja (misalnya di laut)
coded.vl: Only general channels, or channels hard to reach from the workplace (for example at sea)
coded.n: The Commissioner of Labour inquires into disputes of workmen and of employees earning up to $3,000 a month (Part 16). Complaint forms are in Malay and English; no dedicated multilingual migrant channel was found.

coded.fi: Jalur ke izin tinggal jangka panjang
coded.vi: Tidak ada jalur: masa tinggal maksimum tetap, atau masa tinggal tidak dihitung
coded.vl: No route: fixed maximum stay, or time does not count
coded.n: Employment Passes last at most 5 years at a time, renewable. Permanent-residence categories (updated 31 December 2024) are based on family ties or descent, not on employment.

coded.vi: Hanya dalam status berikutnya atau dengan syarat
coded.vl: Only in a later status or on conditions
coded.n: The wife or dependent child of an Employment Pass holder may get a Dependant's Pass at the Controller's discretion and against security; holders may not work without written consent. A husband is not covered.

agreements.t: MOU on the placement and protection of Indonesian workers

changes.en: Brunei's first Minimum Wage Order, limited to two sectors.
changes.id: Perintah Upah Minimum pertama Brunei, terbatas pada dua sektor.
